messages.content: How to save game progress at stage 7 in easy mode and stage 3 in hard mode?

function.name: game_save_progress
function.description: Save the current state of a player's game, given the stage, level and game mode. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

stage.description: The current stage in the game the player has reached.

mode.description: The game mode. Available modes are easy or hard.

We need to call the function twice: one with stage=7, mode="easy", level unspecified; second with stage=3, mode="hard". We need to output JSON calls to the function. According to guidelines, we should not include any other text besides the function calls. But the instructions say: "When you do want to call a function, you must respond with a JSON object containing the name of the function and arguments." And "If you want to provide multiple calls, you can do so in separate messages." So we can send two separate messages each with a function call. Or combine them into one? The guidelines allow multiple calls in separate messages. So we will send first call: {"name":"game_save_progress","arguments":{"stage":7,"mode":"easy"}}. Then second call: {"name":"game_save_progress","arguments":{"stage":3,"mode":"hard"}}.

We should not add any explanation. Just the calls.
